race.comment: LIL MISS RIPLEY (4) was well back throughout but attacked the line to hit the frame when a 2.25 lengths third (19.85) at this track in Grade 5. Makes plenty of appeal. CYCLONE LEO (7) has been settling off the speed lately, finishing sixth (20.21) last time in a Restricted WIN at this track. In the mix. ASTON TOLHURST (2) comes off an average performance last start when fifth at Casino over 484m behind Impressive Gem (28.60) in a Grade 5. The form out of last race has been strong. Has ability and is one of the better chances. MAYWYN'S CHIEF (1) can find the frame without surprising.
